rules.rationale: This is the positive equation of the piecewise expectedDigit summary: it defines the result as the singleton list containing D when D lies in the inclusive interval with endpoints A and B.
This is the complementary negative equation of the expectedDigit summary: it defines the result as the empty list when D does not lie in the unordered inclusive interval.
This macro-style equation defines expected(A, B) by concatenating the expectedDigit summaries for 2, 4, 6, and 8 in ascending order.
